mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile: it connected changes at one spot to a message traveling along the membrane.

leastWorthwhile.text: Developing the insulating cells felt less engaging because it was the only available combination and mostly prepared for the wrapping step.

surprise.text: I was surprised that no single ion has to travel the whole length for a message to move along the nerve cell.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although the chemical-messenger pairing was guided by its name and the compatibility menu rather than an explanation of how the messengers cause development.

continue.text: Yes, I'd try another chapter: seeing the channels and insulating cells come together made me curious about what nerve messages do next.
